title: Experience is a property of physical events themselves

statements.text: Experience belongs to physical events themselves: the fields of physics are fields of qualia, or each objective reduction carries a proto-experience, or experience is a property of systems with the right causal properties.

sources.quote: If the fields of physics are fields of qualia
Consciousness results from discrete physical events; such events have always existed in the universe as non-cognitive, proto-conscious events
the DP proposal suggests each OR event, which is a purely physical process, is itself a primitive kind of ‘observation’, a moment of ‘proto-conscious experience’
The theory holds that consciousness is a fundamental property possessed by physical systems having specific causal properties.
the framework presented here is consistent with [13, 14, 154] in supporting a panpsychist perspective on questions of agency, sentience, and cognition
